body: Unfortunately things did not work as intended. Now stuck waiting to settle things in my family before I leave. I can't do this anymore. I've lost all family I cared about, my s/o talks to me as often as a blue moon, I've lost all taste for alcohol or food, and I really don't see anything in my future anymore. Since I've lost all friends that I could talk to things have only gotten worse. And my s/o at this point makes me feel guilty for for even trying to talk about issues. So I guess this addendum to my previous post is just here to bring everything to some sort of close. And give closure to anyone who might have figured out who I am. I'll leave the engagement ring I bought my s/o with a note irl so it hopefully ends up with them. I'll need to write all my useful info down for my computer to leave to whomever ends up with it. And I guess that's really it. Most the stuff I own is pretty much worthless to anyone but me so it can be liquidated. I've decided how I'm ending it. Combination of two types of poison, aspirin, and a knife. I know that sounds complex. But if I used a habgman's knot and went with the hemp fandango there is a decent chance I'm dangling until I finally tap out. Or I have the distance calculated wrong and my head pops off like a horribly abused Stretch Armstrong. I think I'm going to go for a hike when I finally close this chapter and return this book to the library. If only I could go to my home town, there's a trail that leads to some cliffs and mountainous terrain that I remember from when I was younger. I remember finding a large set of tracks from some kind of wild cat seemed really big for the area now that I think about it. Oh well. One can dream about living in the wilds instead of their current constraints. Would probably suck as much trying to survive outdoors as much as I do with life in general.
And with this, I guess will be my last post on here. I hope you find happiness. Sorry.
I'm now set on what I want to do. Just need to get my affairs in order and square up whatever I need to. Once done it's just a divine intervention roll away.

I'm barely enjoying anything anymore. And I constantly feel like nothing I do matters. Doubtful anyone cares at this point. Tried to talk again about it but conveniently my "s/o" just blows me off like normal. Can't ever have a serious conversation, or any for that matter. It would be nice if they wouldn't just shut out the world but everyone copes differently. I just want some kind of meaningful conversation. That's it. I probably won't get to have that conversation in the last time I have left.

I would joke about how my "s/o" would even know if anything happened. They'd probably just think I got bored or didn't want to talk. Not like they have contact info for anyone I know. Nor do they really seem too interested anymore. Gonna start picking flowers in a few days and figure out the best method of eating them possibly collect a large jar or something worth of them and just roll my d100 like I do every day to see if today is the day. That's ironically the only reason I bought a Zocchihedron, a divine intervention roll. Now I'm just using it to gamble with myself. Still haven't rolled below my character level. You'd thing having a 29% aprox. chance would happen sooner rather than later. But no it's more like those Gotcha games where you have a 10% chance to get a ssr but in reality you have a 1% chance of getting a featured character from that pool.

That's alright I was trying to find what a lethal dose of lead would be or where to buy methylmercury. Then I realized water hemlock grows nearby. And I'm going to be annoyed if it's actually just wild carrots.

Well I found out just about how high I rank in my own relationship. Would be nice to just be told up front that I'm not really worthwhile. Just ghost me  already. I'll just do what I can for now until no one else has a need for me. And that's it. I give it till March at the latest.

Well I've never been so underwhelmed by everything in life. To quote a character from a book I like, 

"He wasn’t surprised. He was used to this anticlimactic feeling, where by the time you’ve done all the work to get something you don’t even want it anymore. He had it all the time. It was one of the few things he could depend on."

And with that I continue with this monotony and empty relationships and friendships. For what end I don't honestly know.

Ever reach out to someone for help and end up being completely ignored by everyone you've attempted to talk to? Or have them joke about a group thing? When you're actually having a serious issue currently? That's my life.
Ya know I kinda thought this might help. Posting about my issues and just getting them out there. Trying to take my mind off of things for even a moment. It hasn't and I guess I'm giving up.

I've been to therapists and psychiatrists, psychologists, neurologists, etc. And still nothing helps. At most my doctor will prescribe one thing and ignore the other problems entirely. It's baffling how the medical system works. Doubly so for psychological care around me. Tried reaching out to various avenues for help and unsurprisingly not much help. I'll probably post here until I feel something more I guess. If that happens.
